step1_analysis.description: This circuit is an RF front-end block, likely a Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) or a tuned amplifier stage for a 9.8GHz UWB transceiver. It features an input common-emitter (or common-source) stage with inductive matching, a cascode device, and LC tanks for frequency tuning.

paper_reference.title: An Ultra-Low-Power 9.8GHz Crystal-Less UWB Transceiver with Digital Baseband Integrated in 0.18µm BiCMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the RF stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = I(VDD) * 1.8V. Assuming a typical bias current of 2-5mA for an RF stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for SKY130 1.8V supply, maintaining low power consumption suitable for UWB.

voltage_gain_9p8G.description: AC voltage gain at the target frequency of 9.8GHz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical gain for a single-stage tuned RF amplifier at ~10GHz in 130nm CMOS.

transient_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output node during transient operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_pp = V_max - V_min from transient analysis.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on input drive strength; expected to be in the hundreds of mV range for linear RF operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption, AC voltage gain at 9.8GHz, and transient output swing. Missing passive values are parameterized for a ~10GHz resonance.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 9.8GHz UWB Transceiver Block Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized values for ~9.8GHz resonance and device sizing
.param L1_val=1n C1_val=100f L2_val=1n L3_val=1n C5_val=100f
.param W_n=10u L_n=0.15u

* Wrapper to map NPN from BiCMOS netlist to SKY130 NMOS
.subckt npn c b e
M1 c b e GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_n} l={L_n}
.ends

* --- DUT ---
L1 B1 LABEL_NET_0 {L1_val}
Q1 N4 B2 B2 npn
Q2 N3 VDD N4 npn
Q3 N0 B1 GND npn
C1 N0 B2 {C1_val}
L2 N0 B2 {L2_val}
L3 VDD N3 {L3_val}
C2 B2 B2 1p
C_BIG N0 N0 1p
C4 B1 B1 1p
C5 N3 GND {C5_val}
* -----------

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 9.8G)

* Load
Rload N3 0 50

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain at 9.8GHz
  ac dec 50 1G 20G
  let gain_db = vdb(N3)
  meas ac gain_at_9p8G find gain_db at=9.8G
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Output Swing
  tran 2p 1n
  meas tran v_max max v(N3)
  meas tran v_min min v(N3)
  let v_pp = v_max - v_min
  print v_pp

  quit
.endc
.end
